# Municipal Ordinance No. KauBayanBlg16S2003, Series of 2003

**Kautusang Bayan Blg. 16**

## Summary

Municipal Ordinance No. 16 (Kautusang Bayan Blg. 16), Series of [[2003]], enacted by the [[Sangguniang Bayan]] of [[Municipality of Pitogo|Pitogo]], Quezon on December 15, 2003. This ordinance regulates the cutting of fruit-bearing trees, specifically prohibiting the cutting of large fruit trees in forests for the purpose of charcoal-making. It aims to preserve fruit trees and promote reforestation in the municipality.

## Key Provisions

- **Section 1** — It is prohibited to cut or destroy any fruit-bearing trees in the forests and woodlands of the municipality of Pitogo, Quezon. This includes trees that provide food and sustenance to the community.
- **Section 2** — It is prohibited to cut or harvest timber from fruit-bearing trees for commercial or charcoal-making purposes.
- **Section 3** — It is prohibited to cut fruit-bearing trees of any species, whether standing or fallen, for firewood, lumber, or charcoal production.
- **Section 4** — Any person found violating this ordinance shall be fined Two Thousand Pesos (P2,000.00) for the first offense, and Five Thousand Pesos (P5,000.00) for subsequent offenses, plus imprisonment of ten (10) to fifteen (15) days as determined by the court.
- **Section 5** — Enforcement shall be carried out by the following:
  1. Department of Agriculture and its representative from the Municipal Agriculture Office
  2. Philippine National Police (PNP)
  3. Punong Barangay (Barangay Captains)
- **Section 6** — All conflicting ordinances or parts thereof are hereby repealed.
- **Section 7** — This ordinance shall take effect upon its approval by the [[Sangguniang Bayan]] of [[Municipality of Pitogo|Pitogo]], Quezon.

## Entities

- [[Sangguniang Bayan]] — enacted the ordinance
- [[Domingo L. Tan]] — Municipal Mayor, approved the ordinance
